logos.name: SOCRadar
logos.notes: White wordmark on transparent — ideal for dark backgrounds. Copied from existing public asset.

logos.name: IBM X-Force
logos.notes: Official IBM 8-bar logo in blue (#1f70c1). X-Force has no distinct standalone SVG mark; IBM corporate logo is the recognised parent identity for the X-Force Threat Intelligence brand.

logos.name: CrowdStrike
logos.notes: Official CrowdStrike falcon + wordmark in red (#fc0000). Also covers CrowdStrike OverWatch.

logos.name: Verizon DBIR
logos.notes: Verizon 2024 wordmark with red checkmark. DBIR is published by Verizon — parent brand is the recognised identity.

logos.name: Mandiant
logos.notes: Official Mandiant wordmark in burgundy (#960a2c). Also covers Mandiant M-Trends.

logos.name: Unit 42
logos.notes: Official Palo Alto Networks dark-mode logo (orange + light). Unit 42 is PAN's threat intel arm; PAN parent brand is the recognised mark. Covers Unit 42 and Palo Alto Unit 42.

logos.name: ENISA
logos.notes: Official ENISA logo from enisa.europa.eu (EU blue + yellow stars motif).

logos.name: Cloudflare
logos.notes: Official Cloudflare orange (#F38020) cloud mark via Simple Icons CDN.

logos.name: Akamai
logos.notes: Official Akamai wordmark + wave logo (blue + orange).

logos.name: Kaspersky
logos.notes: Official Kaspersky wordmark in green (#009982).

logos.name: Check Point
logos.notes: Official Check Point logo from their site. Dark grey wordmark (#231f20) with magenta accent — needs white card on dark background.

logos.name: Dragos
logos.notes: Official Dragos navbar SVG (white-on-transparent variant — ideal for dark background).

logos.name: PCI SSC
logos.notes: Official PCI Security Standards Council teal logo (#006A71). Teal-on-transparent is readable but contrast is borderline on a dark bg — use white card for safety.

logos.name: NVD
logos.notes: NIST/NVD does not publish a distinct vector logo for NVD. NIST master logo exists but is generic. Recommend falling back to NIST logo or keeping monogram chip for this one.

logos.name: CISA
logos.notes: Official CISA seal SVG from cisa.gov asset path. Multi-colour (#005288 blue, #C41230 red, #5E9732 green) — looks great on dark.

logos.name: FBI IC3
logos.notes: Official IC3 PNG logo from ic3.gov. 300x300 raster (no SVG available). Also see fbi-seal.svg in folder if FBI corporate seal is preferred.

logos.name: Cisco Talos
logos.notes: White Cisco corporate logo pulled from talosintelligence.com header. This is the Cisco parent logo (no standalone Talos wordmark) so the Talos sub-brand is implicit. Medium confidence because it shows Cisco rather than Talos explicitly.

logos.name: Red Canary
logos.notes: Joint Red Canary x Zscaler logo from redcanary.com header (Red Canary was acquired by Zscaler in 2025). Standalone pre-acquisition Red Canary SVG is no longer hosted on the site. Medium confidence — the joint lockup may look busy.

logos.name: Black Duck
logos.notes: Official Black Duck logo from their style guide path (purple gradient + duck mark).

logos.name: F5 Labs
logos.notes: Official F5 Networks logo (red ball #e21d38 with white F5). Covers F5 Labs as F5 is the parent.

logos.name: FS-ISAC
logos.notes: Official FS-ISAC SVG from their CDN. Dark wordmark (#231F20) with gradient hexagon mark — needs white card on dark background.

logos.name: World Economic Forum
logos.notes: Official WEF logo (blue #004b86 + white).

logos.name: Sophos
logos.notes: Official Sophos navy-blue (#495390) wordmark.

logos.name: Zscaler
logos.notes: Official Zscaler logo in cyan-blue (#0076be). Covers Zscaler ThreatLabz.

logos.name: Microsoft Security
logos.notes: Official Microsoft logo (four-colour squares + grey wordmark). Microsoft Security is the same parent brand.

logos.name: Rapid7
logos.notes: Official Rapid7 logo from rapid7.com (orange #E85E26).

logos.name: Fortinet FortiGuard
logos.notes: Official Fortinet logo (black wordmark #231f20 + red Fortinet F #ee2e24). Dark wordmark needs white card. FortiGuard is Fortinet's threat research arm — same parent brand.

logos.name: ESET
logos.notes: Official ESET logo in teal-cyan (#0094A1) with white accent.

logos.name: Trellix
logos.notes: Official Trellix logo with gradient fill (despite the filename saying 'black' the actual SVG uses a linear gradient mark — visible on dark backgrounds).

logos.name: Bitdefender
logos.notes: Official Bitdefender logo (black wordmark + red shield). Black wordmark needs white card on dark background.

logos.name: Hoxhunt
logos.notes: Official Hoxhunt logo from their Webflow CDN (pink #EE295C + light).

logos.name: KnowBe4
logos.notes: KnowBe4 logo from vectorlogo.zone (white + gradient). Visible on dark.

logos.name: Proofpoint
logos.notes: Official Proofpoint logo from proofpoint.com (dark grey wordmark #231f20). Needs white card.

logos.name: Coalition
logos.notes: Official Coalition 'Reverse' (white-on-transparent) variant from their Contentful CDN. Designed for dark backgrounds.

logos.name: Constella
logos.notes: Official Constella logo PNG (black wordmark, 385x72). No SVG available on their site. Black wordmark — needs white card.

logos.name: KELA
logos.notes: Official KELA logo PNG from kelacyber.com (black KELA wordmark + red mark, 300x76). No SVG hosted on their site. Needs white card.

logos.name: CYFIRMA
logos.notes: Official CYFIRMA white-variant logo SVG from cyfirma.com — designed for dark backgrounds.

logos.name: Sonatype
logos.notes: Sonatype 2025 favicon SVG (blue 'S' mark). This is the icon mark, not the full wordmark — but it's the only SVG available on their HubSpot CDN. Medium confidence because it's icon-only.

logos.name: Coveware
logos.notes: Coveware homepage banner (2500x894). The full Coveware site is built on Squarespace and does not expose a standalone logo SVG — this banner is the closest thing to a brand asset. Low confidence due to size and being a banner crop rather than a clean wordmark. Forced ?format=2500w to get PNG instead of WebP.

logos.name: Huntress
logos.notes: Huntress 'Logo in Teal' (alt-text matched) from their builder.io CDN — teal (#01C5D1). The non-obvious source: had to scrape huntress.com HTML, regex match alt='Huntress Logo' to find the asset hash, then fetch directly without format params to get raw SVG (with format params it returns WebP).

logos.name: NCSC (UK)
logos.notes: Official NCSC UK logo SVG from ncsc.gov.uk theme assets (white-on-transparent variant — designed for dark headers).

logos.name: PwC
logos.notes: Official PricewaterhouseCoopers logo. PwC wordmark is black with stacked orange/red colour ribbons above — black text needs a white card on dark backgrounds.

logos.name: Censys
logos.notes: Official Censys primary white logo PNG (728x176). Filename specifies 'White' variant — designed for dark backgrounds. PNG only; no SVG exposed on their site.

logos.name: Okta
logos.notes: Official Okta logo in blue (#007DC1).

logos.name: SecurityScorecard
logos.notes: SecurityScorecard icon mark (purple #7033FD) from Simple Icons CDN. Single-colour mark — not the full wordmark, but on-brand.

logos.name: Trend Micro
logos.notes: Official Trend Micro red-on-white variant SVG (red #d71920 + white). 'tm-logo-red-white-t' filename indicates a reversed/dark-bg-friendly variant.
